violations.why: ISR can preempt after the read at 45 (before the mask at 47, or after enable at 50), so the two reads see different values.
The ISR is enabled after line 50 and can run before the disable at 55, between the reads at 51 and 59.
ISR runs between 45 and 47, which sets condition3 to 0 and lets the branch at 56 reach the read at 59, so the two reads see different values.
After enable_isr(1) at line 50 the ISR can set condition3 to 0, so the check at 56 sees a different value than the one at 48.
